title: Implement an approved specification
brief: Write or paste function calculate(input) returning drag in N. Input has rho, V, S, Cd. Reject negative V by throwing Error. Use only these inputs.
supplied: Does the implementation reproduce the declared drag relationship?

rho = 1.2 kg/m³
V = 20 m/s
S = 10 m²
Cd = 0.04 dimensionless
A finite drag in N, or an input error.
Quasi-steady supplied coefficients. Change only the declared independent quantity; other inputs remain fixed.
This is a bounded teaching calculation. It does not establish aircraft safety, successful takeoff, or behavior outside the specified condition.
Doubling speed multiplies drag by four.
At 20 m/s D=96 N; at 40 m/s D=384 N.
Cases: zero speed; baseline; doubled speed; negative speed rejection.
Show controls with units, supplied and student results separately, a result trace, and a clear limitation.
Retain only if all declared cases pass.
hints: Write a function named calculate that returns a finite drag number.
Reject negative speed before evaluating the quadratic relationship.
Check zero speed, the baseline, doubled speed, and the negative-input case.
